notes:
Summary: Localeon builds a multilingual legal-search product for corporate counsel and law firms. They ingest filings, contracts, and translated summaries across 14 languages (EN, FR, DE, ES, IT, NL, PT, PL, SV, DA, FI, CS, HU, RO). Primary need: high-precision retrieval + reranking per language for legal QA and precedent lookup.

Key ask: show end-to-end latency and per-language IR metrics at scale (indexing 40–50M docs). Cost sensitivity is high — they benchmark to $0.001-0.005/query target.

Architecture preference: separate per-language vector shards + a global cross-language reranker for final scoring. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization and per-language quant profiles.

Security: EU data residency mandatory, SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, KMS, audited retention controls. Prefer VPC/private deployment for production; POC ok on dedicated hosted nodes.

Quote from Head of Search (call 2026-02-14): "We need to be able to show counsel that our search is at least as precise as the on-prem solr setup today — recall for FR/DE is the hardest. If latency spikes above 1s users won't adopt."

Sales notes / shorthand: POC started 2026-02-01 — small ingestion -> embed -> rerank. POC dataset = 1.2M docs (multilingual subset). Need per-lang eval dashboard. Next deliverable: perf + MRR by lang + cost breakdown.

Risks: indexing cost for majority-language corpora (DE, FR) could push ARR needs into higher tier; legal teams will require audit logs + e-discovery hooks.
